approval.approval: User delegated investigation and finalization of labelled teaching copies; reviewed context enrichment on 2026-10-21.
approval.description: One native demonstration distinguishes centred pairing from overlapping pairing. Every original pair and query label is unchanged. The original context remains ambiguous under the documented rival family and is not claimed solved. Fresh episodes require their own sufficient demonstrations.

source_review: Native constructor, direct program and independent gate inspected. No native, factory or gate changes. Pure palette substitutions only; no query labels in gate; full query unanimity within ten explicit bridge hypotheses.
background_limit: Gate uses pooled demonstration majority for background. Production dispatch cross-checks palette and fails closed on a mismatch. This is a conservative context limitation, not a proven complete inference rule for arbitrary dense scenes.
finite_hypothesis_limit: Unanimity is relative to the ten documented alignment/blocker hypotheses, not a proof against every imaginable rule. Canonical context not claimed solved.
audit_scope: 250 fixed fresh queries, three demonstrations each: 1000 distinct pairs, 8000 D4 checks. 111 native draw timeouts counted. Context retries do not consult query outputs.
